name: g_bg2dLayerPageSearchOrder
comment: Search order for the four Bg2D layer texture pages (2x u8[4]): bytes 4..7 are each layer's first-choice page id (3,0,1,2), bytes 0..3 are a successor ring (0->1->2->3->0) walked by Bg2D_ResolveLayerTextures when that page is missing from the '2d_bg/%d' resource. It only picks the page slot; the u16 texture ids land in the Bg2DScene layer at +0x62/+0x64.
evidence: Retail rodata bytes at 0x007275DC are 01 02 03 00 and at 0x007275E0 are 03 00 01 02 (8 bytes). Bg2D_ResolveLayerTextures (0x0061CDC8) loads both words through literal slot 0x0061CF50: asm 0x61CDDC ldr r0,[pc,#0x16c] -> 0x007275DC and 0x61CDE0 ldr sb,[pc,#0x16c] -> 0x0000FFFF, then ldr r1,[r0] / ldr r0,[r0,#4] spill the two words to sp+4/sp+8. The outer loop r5=0..3 walks four 6-byte layer entries at self + i*6 (page index +0x60, u16 texture ids +0x62/+0x64); it starts from the sp+8 row indexed by the layer (byte = r5 -> 3,0,1,2) and on a failed page lookup at 0x61CEB8 executes ldrb r0,[fp,r0] with fp = sp+4, i.e. page = row0[page] (0->1->2->3->0), retrying up to 4 times. A page id indexes the resource page table at [self->f_4c->f_8 + 0x34 + id*4] and +0x44 (two name offsets, -1 = absent) resolved via maybe_Gfx_ResourceTrie_Lookup (0x00659668) after strlen (0x0011CCA0); Bg2D_ResetLayerPages/Bg2D_SetTexturePages and maybe_Bg2D_FindTexturePageByName use the same 'layer page' vocabulary. Readable counterpart decomp/readable/functions/Bg2D_ResolveLayerTextures_0061cdc8.c confirms local_2c = *g_0061cf50 is the fallback row and local_28 = g_0061cf50[1] the first-choice row.
